description: Find an emergency dentist (akutt tannlege) in Norway: dental clinics with an emergency duty that has a recorded source (akuttvakt) or that say they take emergency patients, optionally in one county (fylke). Each clinic's `akutt` is "vakt" when the emergency duty has a recorded source (badge «Akuttvakt») and "accepts" when the clinic says it takes emergency patients («Tar imot akuttpasienter»). `count` is the number of matching clinics. Each clinic has its address, phone and profile URL, and when known its opening hours and online booking link. The response also has advice on the municipal out-of-hours dental service (kommunal tannlegevakt).

fylke.description: Limit to clinics in this county. Examples: 'Oslo', 'Vestland'
